label: Android: Install & Launch Debug App
args: ./gradlew installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.example.piximons/.MainActivity

label: Logcat: pidcat (PixiMon)
args: pidcat -c com.example.piximons || { echo; echo "pidcat failed ($?). Press Enter to close."; read -r _; exit 1; }

label: Logcat: pidcat emulator only
args: pidcat -e -c com.example.piximons || { echo; echo "pidcat failed ($?). Press Enter to close."; read -r _; exit 1; }

label: Logcat: pidcat device only
args: pidcat -d -c com.example.piximons || { echo; echo "pidcat failed ($?). Press Enter to close."; read -r _; exit 1; }

label: Logcat: pidcat errors (E+)
args: pidcat -c -l E com.example.piximons || { echo; echo "pidcat failed ($?). Press Enter to close."; read -r _; exit 1; }

label: Emulator: Start small_phone (lite)
args: nohup emulator -avd small_phone -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu host -accel on -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save -no-metrics </dev/null >/tmp/piximon-emu-small_phone.log 2>&1 & echo "started small_phone pid $!  log /tmp/piximon-emu-small_phone.log"; wait $! || { echo emulator exited; tail -20 /tmp/piximon-emu-small_phone.log; echo Press Enter to close; read -r _; exit 1; }
